# NASA Science

> > Official portal for NASA's Science Mission Directorate, covering Earth observation, astrophysics, planetary science, and citizen science projects using missions like James Webb Space Telescope, Hubble, and Voyager.

NASA Science showcases research from the Science Mission Directorate (SMD) across Earth Science Division, Astrophysics Division, and Planetary Science programs. The site features mission updates, educational resources, data repositories, and opportunities for public participation through citizen science projects on platforms like Zooniverse.

## Key Topics

- James Webb Space Telescope (Webb)
- Hubble Space Telescope
- Earth Science Division
- Science Mission Directorate (SMD)
- Citizen Science & Zooniverse
- Exoplanets
- Astrophysics
- Planetary Science
- Climate Change
- Earth Observation
- Space Missions
- Mars Exploration
- Solar System
- Black Holes & Dark Energy
- Satellite Missions

## Core Science Divisions

- [NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov): Homepage for NASA Science missions exploring universe, life, and Earth
- [Earth - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/earth): Earth Science Division overview: satellites, research programs, and data
- [Climate Change - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/climate-change): Earth Science Division climate research using 20+ satellites and studies
- [Universe - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/universe): Universe exploration: exoplanets, stars, black holes, galaxies, dark matter
- [NASA Astrophysics - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/astrophysics): Astrophysics Division: exploring universe origins and searching for life
- [About Us - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/about-us): Science Mission Directorate overview, missions, and career paths
- [About NASA's Earth Science Division - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/earth-science/programs): Earth Science Division programs, leadership, and organizational structure

## News & Mission Updates

- [Latest News, Missions and Discoveries from NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/science-news): Latest NASA Science news covering missions, discoveries, and research updates

## Citizen Science Projects

- [Planet Hunters TESS - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/citizen-science/planet-hunters-tess): Citizen science project: discover exoplanets using TESS light curves
- [Galaxy Zoo - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/citizen-science/galaxy-zoo): Citizen science: classify galaxy shapes from Hubble, JWST, and Euclid images
- [Cloudspotting on Mars - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/citizen-science/cloudspotting): Citizen science: identify Martian clouds using Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter data
- [EXOTIC - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/citizen-science/exoplanet-watch/exotic): EXOTIC software tutorial for Exoplanet Watch telescope data analysis

## Educational Resources

- [Introduction - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/learn/basics-of-space-flight): Space flight basics tutorial for mission operations and interplanetary travel
- [About the Planets](https://science.nasa.gov/solar-system/planets): Solar system planets overview: 8 planets and 5 dwarf planets reference
- [NASA Centers and Facilities - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/about-us/nasa-centers): Directory of NASA centers: Goddard, JPL, Kennedy, Marshall, and more

## Mission FAQs & Support

- [Webb FAQs - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/webb/faqs-full): James Webb Space Telescope FAQs: orbit, mirrors, instruments, and science
- [Hubble FAQs - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/hubble/overview/faqs): Hubble Space Telescope FAQs: operations, pointing control, and imaging
- [Frequently Asked Questions - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/frequently-asked-questions): Voyager mission FAQs: interstellar trajectory, instruments, and spacecraft status
- [FAQs - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/researchers/sara/faqs): ROSES grant program FAQs covering proposals, compliance, and submission

## Optional

- [Rendering an image preview in Blender - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/rendering-an-image-preview-in-blender): Tutorial for rendering 3D model previews using Blender software
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/photojournal/faq): Planetary Data System Photojournal image archive FAQs and false-color imaging
- [OSDR - Help - Contact Us - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/biological-physical/data/osdr/osdr-help-contact-us): Open Science Data Repository contact and help page for biological sciences
- [FAQ - NASA Science](https://science.nasa.gov/eclipses/future-eclipses/eclipse-2023/faq): 2023 annular solar eclipse FAQs covering safety and viewing information
